failure: GID mismatch after the second emulator reboot
rootCause: Deleting Android-managed cache directories while preserving the app root leaves cached inode references on that root. A restored preferences directory can reuse a deleted cache inode and be classified as cache by installd during boot, which changes its GID and permissions.
fix: During app restore and rollback, keep cache and code_cache directory inodes and metadata, clear only their contents, and do not copy old cache directory metadata over them.
